entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I recently received a bike I ordered from you, and unfortunately, it arrived damaged. I'm pretty upset about it.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that! Could you please describe the damage for me?

Well, the first thing I noticed was the **cracked frame**. It’s pretty noticeable right out of the box. And then, when I tried to put it together, I found out one of the wheels is terribly **wobbly wheel**. It barely spins straight. It looks like **shipping damage** to me.

I understand your frustration completely. That definitely sounds like it arrived in unacceptable condition. To make things right, I'm happy to offer you a full refund. We will also provide a **free label** for you to ship the bike back to us at no cost to you.
Really? A full refund and free return shipping? That would be amazing!

Absolutely! I'll process the refund right away. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. I will also email you a prepaid **free label** within the next hour. Just repack the bike in its original box, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Wow, that's fantastic! Thank you so much for taking care of this so quickly and easily.

You're very welcome! We apologize again for the inconvenience caused by the **shipping damage** and the **cracked frame**. We appreciate your business and hope you'll consider VeloFit again in the future.
I definitely will. Your customer service has been excellent. Thanks again, Alex!
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great! Have a wonderful day and enjoy the rest of your day.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Goodbye.
